title: Panshi world fact manifest v1
description: WorldFactManifestV1: the sealed, signed envelope the upstream market-research repository publishes for one current-mode TW market session. This repo only consumes released manifests; it never derives one. This schema is the exact WorldFactManifestV1 TS shape from docs/v5/system-design.md §6.2 — no additional or missing top-level fields. The manifest itself only carries revision ID allowlists; the referenced fact revision records live in the sibling fact-revision.schema.json.

modeDomain.description: This contract only covers the current-mode (live TW session) manifest. Historical-mode manifests are a separate contractVersion/modeDomain pair, not this schema.

manifestId.description: Immutable identifier of this sealed manifest.

manifestHash.description: SHA-256 of the RFC 8785 JCS canonical UTF-8 bytes of this manifest object with the manifestHash and objectHash fields removed. See README.md §Digest convention.

signatureKeyId.description: Identifier of the upstream signing key that sealed this manifest. Never a secret value, only a key reference.

sealedAt.description: When the upstream repository sealed this manifest. Not a world-time boundary by itself.

marketDateTaipei.description: Asia/Taipei market calendar day, matching the sealed-facts v1 market_date_taipei convention.

interactionCutoffAt.description: Upper bound for interaction (exposure/attention/appraisal/action) eligibility: available_at <= min(character_world_time, interactionCutoffAt, CognitionInputSealed.occurred_at).

evidenceCutoffAt.description: Upper bound for outcome/editorial evidence eligibility: available_at <= evidenceCutoffAt. Independent of interactionCutoffAt — neither substitutes for the other.

licenseClass.description: Upstream-owned license taxonomy value. This repo treats it as an opaque, ingest-time gate value, not a semantic it interprets.

rightsValidFrom.description: Ingest/bind gate only. Never substitutes for world time (system-design.md §6.2).

rightsValidUntil.description: Null means open-ended rights validity. Ingest/bind gate only, same caveat as rightsValidFrom.

interactionFactRevisionIds.description: Physically separate allowlist. May ONLY be used for exposure/attention/appraisal/action. A fact revision id may also appear in outcomeEvidenceRevisionIds, but each pipeline must resolve it through its own list's explicit ref — this is not one list reused.

interactionFactSetDigest.description: Digest over interactionFactRevisionIds. See README.md §Digest convention.

outcomeEvidenceRevisionIds.description: Physically separate allowlist. May ONLY be used for paper outcome, correction, and post-close editorial.

outcomeEvidenceSetDigest.description: Digest over outcomeEvidenceRevisionIds. See README.md §Digest convention.

objectUri.description: Location of the mirrored object bundle this manifest seals (this repo's own immutable mirror, not a live upstream query).

objectHash.description: SHA-256 of the RFC 8785 JCS canonical UTF-8 bytes of the mirrored fact-revision bundle at objectUri. See README.md §Digest convention.
